_purpose: Ratchet for the Stage A donor-UI mirror corpora. documents/without-errors are measured by eng/cui-mirror/probe under --strict; any CUI compile error fails. A fall in `documents` means mirrors were lost and must be explained, not absorbed.
evidence_label: CUI compile evidence only. Nothing here is rendered, run natively, packaged or accepted.
_change_reason: 2026-10-31 second pass (1050 -> 1758 documents): the owner's correction that Boards' UI donor is AppFlowy, not rnote. Added the Dart/Flutter dialect, which reads widget constructor calls because AppFlowy has no markup UI, and mirrored 824 files from AppFlowy's lib plus 55 from its design-system packages (all compiling clean). Retired Boards' rnote UI mirror: 31 of its 33 documents were byte-identical to Canvas's, 2 differed, and the two donor checkouts drift in 8 UI files - one shared drawing surface must be pinned once, and the owner's single-implementation requirement forbids keeping two revisions of it. Also fixed an emitter bug that emitted space-only donor text runs as empty CUI values (CUI030, 4 documents).
_gap_ratchet: Two corrections, both found by measurement and recorded rather than absorbed. (1) EXCLUSION BUG: '--exclude test' matched SUBSTRINGS of a path, so it silently dropped 20 genuine donor UI files across the corpora, including swriter/ui/footnotesendnotestabpage.ui, scalc/ui/chisquaretestdialog.ui, scalc/ui/ttestdialog.ui and scalc/ui/ztestdialog.ui - none of which is a test fixture (the match came from 'test' inside 'sendnoTESTabpage' and 'chiSQUARETESTdialog'). Exclusion now matches path segments (or an explicit 'dir/subtree' fragment), and documents rose 1,764 -> 1,784 with all 1,784 compiling clean. The intermediate 1,758 figure measured a moment ago was the over-excluded state, and the ratchet refused to accept a falling count without a reason - which is exactly what it is for. (2) GAP KINDS: gap records are now classified. Of 25376 records, 20767 are genuine CUI framework gaps and 4609 are donor plumbing (web attributes such as form/method/defer/data-*, and inline script/style/observer hooks). The single number before conflated them and overstated the framework queue; the queue in docs/development/cui-framework-extension-queue-2026-10-31.md now separates them. Also fixed a real emitter bug: hyphenated keys in the XUL property map were unreachable because the lookup strips hyphens, so 82 mapped aria-label attributes and 58 data-l10n-id attributes were being reported as unmapped and dropped; accessibility name, tooltip and accesskey now map through, and localisation keys are recorded as their own CUI gap rather than swallowed.
